question: Pandit Kishan Maharaj of Benaras Gharana was a _______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is__** tabla.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Kishan Maharaj of Benaras Gharana was a tabla player.**
 
• He was born on **September 3, 1923, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• ** He was awarded the Padma Shri in 1973 and the Padma Bhushan in 1991 for his contribution to Indian classical music.**
 
• Pandit Kishan Maharaj was known for his unique style of playing tabla, which was a blend of the Banaras and Delhi gharans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santoor**: It is a stringed musical instrument that originated in Persia and is played using mallets. It is not associated with Pandit Kishan Maharaj.
 
• **Flute**: It is a wind instrument that is popular in classical music. It is not associated with Pandit Kishan Maharaj.
 
• **Sarangi**: It is a bowed, stringed instrument that is popular in Indian classical music. It is not associated with Pandit Kishan Maharaj.
